note: ADR-0011 §3.2 first bars. A linear filter bank (two Linkwitz-Riley fourth-order crossovers) and a mid/side matrix: flatness, crossover levels and band widths are measured against their exact values; no THD or aliasing bar applies. The common zipper sweep's tone is centred, so the suite sweeps the widths again on a side-only tone. The crossovers are bilinear Linkwitz-Riley (exactly all-pass in sum). The harness's latency check measures cross-correlation lag, which for an all-pass bank is phase delay (1-2 samples) and not buffering, so the suite holds reported latency 0 instead.
